name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceReadPaperGuideActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user starts the SDK's rewarded reading task. It shows the instructions for swiping through the reading content.
disableEffect: The reading-task guide will no longer appear, and its associated task reward cannot be earned.
